title: Chennai's Day Zero Warning
summary: In June 2019, Chennai's four main surface water reservoirs dropped to under 0.2% of total capacity, cutting municipal piped supply by half and forcing 10 million citizens to rely on 4,000+ daily tanker trucks.
keyLessons: Mandatory rooftop rainwater harvesting on all residential structures.
Restoration of over 200 ancient wetland storage bodies and temple tanks.
Deployment of tertiary treated reverse osmosis (TTRO) plants for industrial water reuse.

title: Cape Town Day Zero Averted
summary: Following a record 1-in-300-year drought, dam levels fell below 20%. Citywide civic discipline and strict 50L/person quotas halved municipal water consumption within months, preventing full system collapse.
keyLessons: Transparent civic communication using real-time reservoir countdown dashboards.
Eradicating water-intensive invasive tree species in mountain catchment basins.
Expanding deep groundwater drilling into the Table Mountain aquifer group.

title: Colorado River & Lake Mead Crisis
summary: Lake Mead, the largest reservoir in the United States, plunged to 27% capacity in 2022 amid a 23-year megadrought, forcing unprecedented tier-2 federal water cuts across 7 basin states and Mexico.
keyLessons: Multistate agreements compensated farmers for voluntary fallowing of alfalfa fields.
Las Vegas implemented aggressive turf buyback programs cutting indoor water consumption.
Installation of low-level pumping intake pipes beneath previous dead-pool levels.

title: Lake Chad Basin Desiccation
summary: Lake Chad has lost ~90% of its surface area due to persistent climate droughts and unsustainable irrigation diversions, triggering mass economic displacement and local conflict for over 30 million people.
keyLessons: Transboundary water basin commission (LCBC) harmonizing irrigation withdrawals.
Transitioning to climate-resilient agro-ecology and solar-powered micro-drip systems.
Restoring indigenous drought-tolerant crops to reduce irrigation water dependency.

title: Sana'a Basin Groundwater Collapse
summary: Unchecked artesian borewell extraction for thirsty qat agriculture has caused the Sana'a water table to fall by 6 to 8 meters every year, putting the city at risk of total groundwater depletion.
keyLessons: Converting diesel pumps to autonomous solar micro-grids to limit excessive pumping.
Reviving historical stepped-terrace water catchment walls in highland valleys.
Emergency municipal water distribution and community chlorination kits.

title: Jordan Highlands Structural Scarcity
summary: With under 61 m³ of renewable water per person annually (88% below UN scarcity lines), Jordan distributes piped water only once weekly, requiring rooftop collection tanks on every home.
keyLessons: Acoustic leak detection deployed across municipal pipelines to recover lost water.
Treating 100% of municipal wastewater for agricultural reuse in the Jordan Valley.
Construction of the National Water Carrier Red Sea desalination pipeline.
